## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Relevant manual or Docker checks completed, if applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated for settings, routes, environment variables, or workflows

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, webhook URLs, encryption keys, databases, logs, or private media paths are included
- [ ] Media-processing behavior and filesystem effects are described

## Notes

Call out migrations, compatibility considerations, or follow-up work.
